issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs: "nor touch the separate S2 (lock-root/digest portability) or W1/W2/W3 gate work" — S2 has a parenthetical gloss, but W1/W2/W3 are letter+number codes with zero expansion anywhere in the text. Grepped docs/requirements/decisions/*.md (including proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md, which does define S2) and found no definition of W1, W2, or W3 anywhere in the repo. A fresh reader cannot tell what out-of-scope work these codes refer to.

Closing self-check gap: background.md Solution Tradeoffs commits to TWO deliverables — (1) route dev_finish/dev_merge through runStoryTransition, and (2) add a per-story transition lock held across read->gate->persist so same-owner concurrent transitions serialize (the second, related defect described in Key Insights). checklist.json has only CHK-001 "Implement fix for reproduced failure", whose context ("Probe: rp-mrqf6efm-6wotja, Review: rr-mrqf729k-l0qs9c") ties only to the repro that exercises defect #1 (the dev_finish bypass). Neither the title nor context of CHK-001 names the concurrency/mutex deliverable. Since checklist length is 1 (<=2) and index.json has no riskSignals populated, this story is fast-track-eligible (INIT_CHECK could skip PLAN straight to DEV per CLAUDE.md), so there is no guaranteed PLAN-phase scope-check to catch that the locking fix is not explicitly tracked as a separate verifiable checklist deliverable.

Minor standalone-readability gaps: background.md Trigger Event says "cross-host audit (codex + agy)" — "agy" (Antigravity host) is never expanded anywhere in the text; and "candidate probe rp-mrqf6efm-6wotja, red-reviewed target-bug rr-mrqf729k-l0qs9c" uses repro-first-methodology jargon ("probe", "target-bug") that is documented in docs/requirements/decisions/repro-first-story-intake-experiment.md but not linked or glossed inline. Both are inferable from surrounding context so this is advisory only.
